en: Black‑and‑white postcard reproducing a historical painting of a battle scene in a mountainous landscape. Soldiers in 19th‑century uniforms, some on horseback and some marching on foot, advance through rocky terrain while artillery and wagons cross a stream or rough road. Smoke and fighting are visible in the distant valley. The lower margin carries an Italian caption identifying the scene as the Battle of Bezzecca with a date in 1866.
